edges.sentence: On 2026-10-06, USA Today reported “According to the Florida Department of Health, as of Sept. 26, there were been 252 cases of locally acquired cases of dengue reported in seven counties, up from the 190 reported Sept. 19.”; on the same day, USA Today reported “According to the FDOH's Arbovirus Surveillance Report, "252 cases of locally acquired dengue and 20 mosquito pools have been reported from seven counties" as of Sept. 29, but none had previously been reported in Broward.”.

On 2026-10-06, USA Today reported “The report for the period from Sept. 20 through Sept. 26 says that "252 cases of locally acquired dengue and 20 mosquito pools have been reported from seven counties" in 2026.”; on the same day, USA Today reported “According to the FDOH's Arbovirus Surveillance Report, "252 cases of locally acquired dengue and 20 mosquito pools have been reported from seven counties" as of Sept. 29, but none had previously been reported in Broward.”.

On 2026-10-06, USA Today reported “The report for the period from Sept. 20 through Sept. 26 says that "252 cases of locally acquired dengue and 20 mosquito pools have been reported from seven counties" in 2026.”; on the same day, USA Today reported “According to the Florida Department of Health, as of Sept. 26, there were been 252 cases of locally acquired cases of dengue reported in seven counties, up from the 190 reported Sept. 19.”.

On 2026-10-06, USA Today reported “Hillsborough County, home of Tampa, saw 223 of the 252 reported dengue cases this year.
